data.name: A Catalan Sword
data.detailed_description:
A Catalan Sword is a 2D RPG with turn based combat, where you play as a mercenary of the Byzantine Empire during the historical expedition of 1303. You start as a simple recruit, threaten by your own companion as well as your enemies. You will have to prove yourself by the sword and use your wits to gained the respect of your peers and raise among the mud. In the end surviving the battlefield and the nest of viper (aka byzantine court) would be a most than acceptable achievement for most. But for those who seek fame and fortune, the risks will definively provide greater rewards, beyond imagination.

A Singular RPG

This game is a RPG with visual novel dialogue style with a tactical turn-based combat, involving many variables, and a lot of events where your choices will determine your fate based upon your skills.

Survival

The purpose of this game is to survive and reach the end of the expedition. The game features severals survival mechanics with extensive usage of your attributes through perilous skill checks depending on the choices you make.

Turn Based Combat

The turn-based combat system involving many variables including characters’ stats and attributes, but also fatigue level, various traumas and injuries, morale, weapon reach, confined space and high ground. The combats are very tactical and a less experienced character can outsmart the veteran and beat them.

Choice and Consequences

All of the actions that your character takes will have in-game consequences. The NPCs will change their opinions of you depending on how you treat them and how you behave both inside and outside of battle. This in turn will enable or disable various future interactions with them and sometimes trigger special events.

Stats and personalisation 

Make good use of any loot or supplies that you got your hands on. A lot of them can be choose from a wide array of authentic medieval defensive equipment: from all kinds of helmets and armor to gorgets, bracers, greaves and chainmail stockings. All with varying qualities and characteristics.

data.short_description: A Catalan Sword is a 2D RPG with turn based combat, set in the Byzantine Empire of 1303. As a young mercenary survive by choosing battles wisely, training effectively, keeping morale, and knowing when to avoid risks. Become a powerful nobleman, a veteran mercenary or just another corpse in Anatolia.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 6100 | AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 | AMD Radeon R7 265
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 | Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 | AMD Radeon RX 480
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
